lightgbm_diagnostic.scope: Diagnostic on train and validation, after selection. Not eligible for selection.

notes: xgboost, lightgbm, catboost were statistically indistinguishable on validation PR-AUC. catboost ranked first, and the pre-registered rule selected xgboost. This does not show that xgboost is better.
Validation results guided every choice. Test results come from a single evaluation, made after the model and threshold were frozen, and nothing was tuned on them.
Test had a much higher fraud rate than validation, which raises precision and PR-AUC without the model improving.
LightGBM's results with the original distribution and with class weighting reflect a numerical divergence during fitting, not those strategies. See the LightGBM diagnostic.
All results come from the synthetic PaySim simulator.

thresholds.objective: Highest recall with a false positive rate of at most 0.001 on validation. A false positive rate does not depend on prevalence, whereas precision and F1 do.
